blocks.x: The first time I went camping, I was four months old. Since then, I like to say I’ve done my fair share of time on the trails: sleeping in tents, gazing up at the stars, and hiking hundreds of miles. Thanks to dozens of years of experience, I know that one of the most important aspects of an outdoor adventure is the gear you bring along with you; while it doesn’t have to be expensive, it does have to be good quality. From hiking pants and rain jackets to sleeping bags and tents, Mountain Hardwear is an almost one-stop shop for all you need on your next nature-focused getaway. Whether you’re spending a week or two roughing it in a spectacular US national park, or enjoying a night of good old-fashioned backyard camping with the kids, this is the gear that will keep you warm, dry, and comfortable. Read on for the best promo codes, discounts, and ways to save with Mountain Hardwear before you head out on your next big adventure.
Mountain Hardwear discount code: 15% off first orders with email or text sign-up

First-time shopper? Here’s an incentive to hit “check out.” New customers can get a Mountain Hardwear promo code for 10% off their first order when they sign up for email notifications. Sign up for text notifications as well, and your discount increases to 15% off. Your code will be delivered directly to either your email or phone number, so you’ll be able to get shopping without delay. Plus, once you sign up, you’ll get all the best brand information delivered right to your inbox, including new product launches, upcoming sale information, and exclusive promotions. What does this mean for you? That the savings never end.
Become an Elevated Rewards member to save even more

If you plan to purchase even a single item from Mountain Hardwear, it’s worth your time (and money) to sign up to be a Mountain Hardwear Elevated Rewards member. Shoppers can sign up for the free rewards program and score excellent member deals, starting with 15% off members’ first orders, so you can reap some immediate rewards.

Whether you’re shopping around for a new pair of leggings and light layers, or doing in-depth research on heavy-duty backpacking gear and three-person tents, it’s best to start off your journey on the right foot: with a deal. You’ll also get free ground shipping regardless of how big or small your purchase is, and a 20% off coupon on your birthday every year. Plus, you’ll want to keep your email notifications on, since members get exclusive member-only offers, early access to sales, and points on every purchase that can be redeemed for future savings.
Save up to 70% at the Mountain Hardwear Outlet without a coupon

While it may seem counterintuitive, camping and hiking are not cheap activities. Sure, you’re saving on hotels and entertainment costs, but the cost of all the high-quality products you need to bring along to ensure you have a safe and enjoyable journey can really add up. Mountain Hardwear Outlet is where you can shop for all your favorite products at exceptional deals. Whether you’re in the market for clothing (find up to 50% off out-of-season products like men’s and women’s hoodies and jackets), or looking for travel equipment like backpacks or sleeping bags (also up to 50% off), there’s something for everyone. I’m particularly eyeing the women’s Kor Airshell hybrid hooded jacket—I love that it’s lightweight and rain-resistant—and the women’s Crater Lake heavyweight half zip, which is perfect for layering on chilly hikes. This is also the ideal place to stock up on larger ticket items, like snowsports gear—the women’s Boundary Ridge Gore-Tex jacket is a whopping $230 off.

For even greater savings, head to the Last Chance Outlet page, which offers deals of up to 70% off past seasonal styles. All deals are final. Sure, this means you'll be browsing through a slew of summer gear while shopping in the winter, but if you’re not planning that far ahead, there are still plenty of versatile products that can be worn year-round, like the women’s Mountain Stretch tight—a massive 71% off and available in all sizes XS–XL—and the women’s Canyon long sleeve at 40% off.
How to fix a Mountain Hardwear promo code that’s not working

If you have trouble with your promo code, there are a few things you can do to fix it. First, be sure to check for any typos or errors in the code itself, paying special attention to things like capitalization and letters that look like numbers. Then, glance at the fine print and make sure that you haven’t surpassed the expiration date, that the order meets all requirements for the terms and conditions, and that your cart meets all necessary criteria to qualify for the code. If everything seems to be in order but the coupon is still not working, consider restarting your browser, switching to a different device, or clearing your cookies and cache to rule out any hardware or software issues. Your final option is to reach out to Mountain Hardwear’s customer support team for personalized help.
